_comment: Yanlış Renk — English texts. Do not change keys. {0},{1}: placeholders. Plurals: {0,plural,one{...} other{...}}. Do not use square brackets (color tag syntax).
brand.tagline: Don't let the colors fool you!
duel.1_oyuncu_kapi_2: Player 1: {0,plural,one{# gate} other{# gates}}   ·   Player 2: {1,plural,one{# gate} other{# gates}}
duel.ikiniz_ayni_pisti_oynarsiniz: You both play the same track · No lives used
duel.telefonu_masaya_koyun_karsilikli:
Put the phone on the table and sit facing each other.
Bottom half is Player 1, top half is Player 2.
Tap your own half to change color.
First one through a wrong gate is out!
game.bolumu_yeniden_baslatmak_basarisiz: Restarting counts as a failed attempt and costs 1 life.
game.can_kalkani_canini_korudu: Your Life Shield saved a life!
game.cikarsan_deneme_basarisiz_sayilir: If you quit, this attempt counts as a fail and you lose 1 life.
game.ekrana_dokun_kirmizi_mavi: Tap the screen: Red > Blue > Green > Yellow
game.en_az_altin_topla: Collect at least {0,plural,one{# coin} other{# coins}}
game.hiz_surekli_artar_kombo: Speed keeps rising. Chain combos to grow your score multiplier!
lives.out_body: Each life refills on its own in {0,plural,one{# minute} other{# minutes}}, even while the game is closed. Don't want to wait? Try the options below.
map.alanda_ogrendigin_her_seyi: A big {0}-gate exam on everything you learned in this area.
map.tamamladigin_alanlari_daha_hizli: Replay areas you've completed, faster and with memory gates.
map.ustalik_daha_hizli_hafiza: Mastery: faster versions with memory gates
menu.cihaz_yeniden_basladi_internete: Device restarted; the pending time will be added once you're online.
menu.ekranin_herhangi_yerine_dokun: Tap anywhere on the screen. Your character turns Red > Blue > Green > Yellow in order.
menu.esit_degildir_isaretli_kapidan: Pass a not-equal gate in a color DIFFERENT from the gate's color.
menu.esittir_isaretli_kapidan_kapiyla: Pass an equals gate while you're the SAME color as the gate.
menu.kapilarda_karakterde_daire_kare: Circle, square, triangle and star shapes on gates and your character
menu.renk_korlugu_destegi_kirmizi: Color-blind support: Red circle, Blue square, Green triangle, Yellow star. You can turn it on or off in Settings.
menu.sunucuya_ulasilamadi_cevrimdisi_mod: Couldn't reach the server. Offline mode: the life timer only runs while the device stays on.
menu.tum_bolumler_paralar_karakterler: All levels, currency and characters will be deleted. This can't be undone.
menu.tutorial_lives_body: Fail a level and you lose 1 life. Each life refills in {0,plural,one{# minute} other{# minutes}}. Endless Mode is always free!
menu.ustalik_icin_once_alani: Complete an area first to unlock Mastery
menu.yanlis_kapida_kisa_titresim: Short buzz on a wrong gate
menu.yanlis_renk_yazi_tipi:
Yanlış Renk {0} · {1}
Font: Nunito (SIL OFL 1.1). All art and sounds were made for this project.
prog.100_parca_her_alani: {0}/100 pieces · Finish an area to earn a piece. All 5 pieces of a world = +20 diamonds.
prog.bugunun_odulunu_aldin_yarin: You've claimed today's reward. Come back tomorrow!
prog.can_kalkani_aktif_siradaki: Life Shield active: your next fail won't cost a life.
prog.gercek_oyuncu_siralamasi_icin: Real player rankings need a server connection; this version only shows your personal bests.
prog.hafta_herkes_ayni_parkuru: This week everyone plays the same course. Every run has:
prog.lives_regen_info: Each missing life refills in {0,plural,one{# minute} other{# minutes}}. The timer runs even when the game is closed.
prog.not_cihaz_yeniden_baslatildi: Note: The device was restarted; a new day unlocks once the time is verified online.
prog.reklam_su_an_hazir: Ad not ready yet, try again in a bit
prog.seri_gun_gun_kacirirsan: Streak: {0,plural,one{# day} other{# days}} · Miss a day and the cycle starts over.
shop.kostumler_gorunumu_degistirir_oyun: Costumes change your look, not the game balance.
shop.lives_info: Lives: {0}/{1}. Life boosts can also be earned from missions and daily rewards.

mech.SAME.title: Color Match
mech.SAME.hint: Pass through = gates in the SAME color. Tap the screen to change your color.
mech.DIFF.title: Opposite Gate
mech.DIFF.hint: Pass through not-equal gates in a DIFFERENT color.
mech.DOUBLE.title: Double Gate
mech.DOUBLE.hint: Two gates in a row. Plan ahead for both.
mech.SPEED.title: Speedway
mech.SPEED.hint: Your character speeds up in speed zones marked with arrows.
mech.MEMORY.title: Color Memory
mech.MEMORY.hint: The gate's color hides as you get close. Remember it!
mech.LOCK.title: Locked Color
mech.LOCK.hint: In lock zones some colors can't be used; tapping skips them.
mech.ROTATE.title: Spinning Gate
mech.ROTATE.hint: The gate's colors slide along. Which color will be in the middle when you get there?
mech.RAINBOW.title: Rainbow Gate
mech.RAINBOW.hint: If a gate shows several colors, any of them gets you through.
mech.TIMED.title: Time Gate
mech.TIMED.hint: The gate's color changes at set intervals. Watch the timer ring.
mech.MAZE.title: Color Maze
mech.MAZE.hint: All kinds of gates, mixed and coming fast. Stay calm!
mech.MIRROR.title: Mirror World
mech.MIRROR.hint: In mirror zones the color order is reversed: Yellow > Green > Blue > Red.
mech.HIDDEN.title: Hidden Gate
mech.HIDDEN.hint: Some gates only appear when you get close.
mech.STROOP.title: Tricky Color
mech.STROOP.hint: The eye badge on the gate shows what to look at: brush = PAINT color, book = WORD.
mech.TRIPLE.title: Triple Gate
mech.TRIPLE.hint: Three gates in a row! Think fast.
mech.AUTOSHIFT.title: Color Shift Pad
mech.AUTOSHIFT.hint: Run over a pad and your color changes by itself.
mech.SLIDE.title: Moving Lane
mech.SLIDE.hint: Two-color gates slide left and right. Go by the color in the middle.
mech.CHAIN.title: Memory Chain
mech.CHAIN.hint: A sign shows the colors of the next gates; the gates themselves arrive gray.
mech.MIX.title: Color Mix
mech.MIX.hint: You can pass a two-color gate with either of its two colors.
mech.QUICK.title: Snap Decision
mech.QUICK.hint: Gates come more often. Less time to react!
mech.EXAM.title: Big Exam
mech.NONE.title: Forbidden Colors
mech.NONE.hint: Don't pass with any of the crossed-out colors.
mech.NEXT.title: Next Color
mech.NEXT.hint: Forward-arrow gate: pass with the color that comes AFTER the one shown (Red > Blue > Green > Yellow).
mech.PREV.title: Previous Color
mech.PREV.hint: Back-arrow gate: pass with the color that comes BEFORE the one shown.
mech.REPEAT.title: Echo Gate
mech.REPEAT.hint: Loop-arrow gate: pass with the same color you used at the previous gate.
mech.DECOY.title: Fake Gate
mech.DECOY.hint: Dashed-line fake gates don't count; any color gets through.
mech.FLICKER.title: Flickering Gate
mech.FLICKER.hint: These gates blink on and off. Catch them while they're visible.
mech.FOG.title: Fog
mech.FOG.hint: In fog zones you can't see far ahead.
mech.COINS.title: Color Coins
mech.COINS.hint: You can only collect color coins while you're the same color.
mech.WAVE.title: Wave Speed
mech.WAVE.hint: Speed keeps rising and falling. Catch the rhythm.
